subject: prd/existing-repo-onboarding
statement: When the undo step is run, the system shall remove the installation — unchaining any chained hook to restore the prior hook path, deleting the paths adoption added, and clearing the epoch — preserving all post-adoption work, and shall name any manual addition for the human to reverse.
rationale: reversibility is the trust lever; removal, not snapshot-revert, so a week of the operator's own work survives (D-8; refined by D-11)
fit_criterion: after adopt → undo on the fixture, the whole tree is byte-identical to its pre-adoption state; a post-adoption commit made before undo survives
